target_customer: Individual clinicians (paid monthly subscription) and later health systems via an enterprise EHR integrated offering
problem: Clinicians need help building differential diagnoses and clinical plans, and medical software lagged other sectors.
business_model: B2C style subscription for clinicians plus planned enterprise licensing to health systems
product_category: AI clinical decision support and ambient scribing

founders.name: Dereck Paul
founders.background_notes: Physician; internal medicine resident at Brigham and Women's per YC page and TechCrunch

founders.name: Graham Ramsey
founders.background_notes: Engineer at Modern Fertility per TechCrunch Sept 2023

competitors.name: Babylon Health
competitors.what: AI diagnostics and telehealth, faced scrutiny over performance claims

competitors.name: ChatGPT
competitors.what: General LLM used by clinicians informally

technical_complexity.rationale: Built on LLMs grounded in physician authored guidelines. The hard parts were clinical validation and safety, not model research.

defensibility.rationale: Physician written guidelines add some differentiation, but foundation model vendors, UpToDate and Doximity could offer similar features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Doximity later added clinical reference and AI features through its Pathway acquisition per 2025 comparison articles; Glass added ambient scribing and remained independent.

market_need_then: Clinicians were adopting ChatGPT informally in early 2023, and Glass reported over 59,000 users and a waitlist of 15 health systems and companies by September 2023.

branding.domain_note: Uses glass.health, a .health domain rather than glass.com.
branding.community_and_virality: Founder interviews and a Launch YC post for Glass AI reported more than 50,000 queries and 5,000 sign-ups; no evidence of merch.

brand_strength.rationale: Plain word brand with growth driven by product launches and ChatGPT era interest rather than the brand itself.

pivots.from: Physician knowledge notebook for learning and practicing medicine
pivots.to: Generative AI diagnosis and clinical plan tool
pivots.why: Large language models made AI differential diagnosis feasible; TechCrunch dates the pivot to early 2023

outcome_analysis: Glass Health pivoted in early 2023 from a physician notebook to an AI diagnosis tool just as ChatGPT drove clinician interest, then raised a 5 million seed in September 2023 after reaching tens of thousands of users. A physician CEO gave founder market fit. It stays active and has added ambient scribing, though crowded competition from Doximity and big model vendors remains the main risk.
notes: Total raised is reported as 6.5M by TechCrunch (1.5 pre-seed plus 5 seed) while aggregators say 5M to 7M. The YC page fetch listed a William Hart as CTO; this was not confirmed by any second source, so he is not listed as a founder. CB Insights lists an April 2024 Google for Startups accelerator entry, not recorded as a round.
